title: prospect-snapshot
description: Contract C. A versioned, read-only export produced by tokencoup-skills-backlink-prospector. The consumer validates the version and rejects unknown fields rather than silently ignoring them. Version 1.1.0 adds an optional discovery block per prospect (submission_url, form_shape, form_fields, contact_email, contact_source, contact_source_url, enriched_at); every added field is optional, so a 1.0.0 producer keeps working.

center_domain.description: The center domain (domain A) whose pool was exported.

file.description: Upstream store file the export was derived from.

url.description: Site entry point. NOT the page where a link will appear.

submission_url.description: Absolute URL of a page hosting a submission form, discovered by a read-only crawl. Absent means nobody looked, not that none exists.

form_shape.description: Host-independent hash of the form's normalised field names and method, so one reviewed mapping can serve every site that shares a form shape.

form_fields.description: Field names observed on the form, in page order.

contact_email.description: Address found on the site. Never guessed at the domain.

contact_source.description: How the address was obtained; keeps provenance auditable.

contact_source_url.description: Page the address was read from.

enriched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the discovery pass that produced the fields above.
